name: nw-mineral-monitor
description: Build and acceptance dependencies for WS12 mine-file and GIS tools

scripts.vendor:pdfjs: mkdir -p site/assets/pdfjs/standard_fonts site/assets/pdfjs/wasm && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.min.mjs node_modules/pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs site/assets/pdfjs/ && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/LICENSE site/assets/pdfjs/LICENSE && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/standard_fonts/* site/assets/pdfjs/standard_fonts/ && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/wasm/* site/assets/pdfjs/wasm/
scripts.vendor:three: mkdir -p site/assets/three && cp node_modules/three/build/three.module.min.js node_modules/three/build/three.core.min.js site/assets/three/ && cp node_modules/three/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js site/assets/three/ && cp node_modules/three/LICENSE site/assets/three/LICENSE
scripts.test:geomodel: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_geomodel_*.py' && node tools/test_gm_formats.mjs && node tools/test_gm_engine.mjs && node tools/test_gm_structural.mjs
